about.description: Orca lets you run a fleet of bots with your own subscription (e.g. Claude Code, Grok, Agy, Codex). Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.

body: Thank you for using Orca and sharing your feedback. ❤️ ## Clearer bot items, more controls on the phone & smoother browser sessions ✨ - 🤖 **See what needs attention.** Bot panels show upcoming runs. Item links preview GitHub pull requests and issues on hover, and questions retain their labels when an answer is waiting to send. - 📱 **Manage more from the phone.** Open Google, GitHub and Linear account controls, find agents and groups by name, and post to groups across computers. - 🌐 **Work with streamed browser pages.** Scroll more smoothly over slower links, open select menus from the keyboard, and print a streamed page to PDF on the desktop. - 🖥️ **More room for workspace tools.** App-rail destinations fill the window. The usage meter stays visible in chat and updates with less background work when a workspace changes. - 💬 **Pick up a conversation.** Browse images across messages and use the session history right away when resuming a chat. ## About Orca Bots (Beta) Orca Bots can coordinate agents and workers across your computers. This release makes it easier to see upcoming runs, track open questions and connect Google accounts. - **Upcoming runs:** Check the next run time in a bot’s panel. - **Item questions:** See which question an answer belongs to, including when a newer question has replaced it. - **Sharing skills:** The preview follows the folders selected in the Share dialog. ## Coming soon - More connectors - Easier moves for bots between computers - More performance improvements - Improvements to pull request review, plugins and the sidebar --- ## What's Changed ### 🤖 Bots, connectors & access *Bot panels show upcoming runs at a glance, and Google setup and shared-skill previews are easier to use.* * Virtualize collapsed Bots avatars and show directional counts by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47622 * Wake alerts fire once, then hourly, and can switch rules off per deployment by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47541 * Keep automation runs open across a quit so startup re-judges them by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47855 * Run fixed-time crons once across DST transitions and reject unknown --timezone names by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47876 * Truncate a long run result label instead of overflowing into Workspace by @mmarkert in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47865 * Drop combining accent marks so accented names stay one word in bot folder names by @akira-fukue in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47874 * A from=me pull request rule starts for every pull request opened under the owner's account by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47879 * Show Status Peek in the collapsed Bots row by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47884 * Start a new Google app setup when one already exists by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47820 * Tell the agent about a Connect-card Google sign-in without posting it as the owner's message by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47823 * Report turns cut by a restart to linked conversations by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47898 * Compact the bot hover card by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47939 * Explain read access refusals by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47257 * Keep shared-skill previews aligned with the selected folders and build by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47895 * Redesign Connect Google as two one-line cards by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47861 * Show the resolved model in Bot Settings by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/48009 * To stay silent a bot writes only NO_REPLY; any other words are its reply by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47962 * Give New bot picture arrows room and keep the Generate draft by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47173 * Show next run times in the bot panel by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/48090 * A Stop that takes back a waiting Slack message reads as stopped, not an error by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47482 * Label journal closes from chats that aren't the owner's by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47779 * Reconnecting a saved Google account signs in through the app it signed in with by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47790 * Let agents set the default Google account by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47814 * Offer 'Set up a new Google app' from Use another account and the sign-in card by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47905 * Show other agents' waiting messages at the end of the chat, not in my queue by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/45882 ### 💬 Native chat *Browse images across messages, pick up a session from history, and open newly created chats from the workspace sidebar.* * Step through the images in view across messages by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47457 * Show the temporary worker banner across the top of a chat worker, as in a terminal by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43521 * Move focus to the split whose Stop/Send button you click by @dzkchen in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47784 * Preload session history and run submitted /resume searches immediately by @dzkchen in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47815 * Fill the resume toast's Resume button with the theme accent by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47859 * Drop the question card's step bar; the count and arrows show progress by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47959 * Show new Claude and Codex chats in the workspace sidebar before the first send by @dzkchen in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47929 * An ask to an unnamed paired computer never reads "on " by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47961 * Wrap long URLs in item comment bubbles instead of widening the chat by @tech-hoon in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47998 * Keep the launch effort when a terminal agent starts on its default model by @yohangwak in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47975 * Summarize every file of one multi-file apply_patch in native chat by @2SinceJuly in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/48038 * Use plain language when a chat cannot open by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/48079 * Say a removed project's chat is removed instead of asking to retry by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47679 ### 🧠 Agents, models & accounts *Agent settings show the selected model more clearly, and account cards offer a sign-in action where it is needed.* * Let background subagent starts right after Esc mark the row working by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47627 * Install status hooks into zcode-app-cli's setting.json too by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47834 * Install managed hooks where Droid reads them by @2SinceJuly in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47853 * Keep a Task worker's hooks off the pane's agent row by @2SinceJuly in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47836 * Keep Antigravity's full model list when agy models comes back short by @orca-remote-automation[bot] in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47341 * Show a saved level model as its family and level in the chat composer by @zjffdu in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/48017 * Show permission descriptions as tooltips by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42557 * Fix agent history badges at narrow widths by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/48095 * Use the question bubble for blocked agents by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/48125 * Pass quote-only JSON arguments to Bun-backed .cmd shims with libuv-style quoting by @s4lmon778 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47764 ### 🤝 Workers & coordination *Item questions and worker status give more context when a task needs attention.* * An agent's own running worker means In progress, not Waiting by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47818 * A worker whose agent is slow to start reads as starting, not unobserved by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47575 * Exited workers read as stopped, shared working glyph and full-width hover in the worker tray by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47774 * Record workers started from any in-app chat under that chat by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47548 * A new set of questions replaces earlier unanswered ones by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47869 * Say which selector failed and that nothing started by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47893 * Say what is known when a worker goes quiet by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47947 * Show the GitHub preview card when hovering an item's PR or issue link chip by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/48003 * Show only the PR link, not its cached state, in work lists and turn notes by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/48005 * https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47262 ### 🗂️ Workspaces, sidebar & tabs *App-rail pages use more of the window, and the sidebar keeps the active workspace visible.* * Keep the active workspace
